slides.headline: Meta deletes criticism of its AI glasses
Video showed glasses recording secretly
slides.body: A reviewer filmed Meta staff without their knowledge using the AI glasses at Meta headquarters.

slides.headline: Meta claimed copyright to remove it
slides.body: Meta used a copyright strike to force YouTube to take down the critical review video.

slides.headline: Glasses look like normal eyewear
slides.body: The Ray-Ban Meta glasses have hidden cameras that record video without an obvious red light.

slides.headline: No law stops this in public
slides.body: In most places, anyone can wear recording glasses and film you without asking permission.

slides.headline: Who watches the watchers?
slides.body: Follow for AI privacy stories that affect your daily life.
